scope: Fix exactly the four witnessed compute regressions; extend native producer proofs through pagination and merged collection jobs.

changes.problem: A default-allow-ssh rule declaring only DENY was reported as exposing public ingress because only name and source range were read.
changes.fix: Read allowed_entries through the strict existing native helper and require a nonempty validated ALLOW declaration before public-ingress failure.
changes.preserved: Existing applicability, source range, disabled/egress, default-name exceptions and evidence semantics are retained. Denied/malformed ALLOW evidence remains UNKNOWN.

changes.problem: First safe ssl_policy/service_usage observation could hide a conflicting later native payload, including separate jobs merging the same collection.
changes.fix: Compare native payload on repeated ssl_policy/service_usage identity, excluding only collector identity/provenance/relationship/representation/aggregate-location metadata. Conflict marks inventory partial/malformed; identical observations merge source request references.
changes.preserved: Existing IAM-policy reconciliation, duplicate IAM-role/project/bucket rejection and log-entry conflict checks are unchanged. Existing read errors continue to keep the inventory incomplete.
changes.malformed_behavior: Good/malformed conflicts in either order stay UNKNOWN; repeated identical malformed payload stays UNKNOWN in the evaluator without being converted into a safe configuration.
